The `.strict()` modifier is the mechanism that rejects a client-supplied full `IForce`, `playerId`, or `role` field on the payload -- any extra key fails schema validation rather than being silently accepted or merged.

src/types/multiplayer/Protocol.ts:533-542 -- the outer `CampaignParticipationSchema`/`ICampaignParticipation` frame carries its own top-level `playerId` (the wire-authenticated sender), separate from and never merged into `participation` -- there is structurally no field on the wire frame through which a client can assert a different acting identity or role for the participation itself.

src/lib/multiplayer/server/bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts:393 -- `if (envelope.playerId !== verifiedPlayerId)` rejects any frame (including CampaignParticipation) whose self-declared `playerId` does not match the connection's server-verified identity, before dispatch to `handleCampaignParticipation` at line 609-610.

src/lib/multiplayer/server/bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts:1323-1382 `handleCampaignParticipation()` -- receives `verifiedPlayerId` as a parameter from the connection binder (never read off the client payload) and passes it straight to `admitBoundCampaignParticipation`; the accepted broadcast frame at line 1367-1376 sets `playerId`/`role` from `admitted.record` (server-derived), never from `envelope.participation`.

src/lib/multiplayer/server/authorizeCampaignParticipation.ts:38-61 `admitBoundCampaignParticipation()` -- looks up a per-socket `ICampaignParticipationBaseline` (captured earlier at connection-bind time via `captureCampaignConnectionBaseline`, called at bindCampaignSyncConnection.ts:950) and rejects with `AUTH_REJECTED`/`rebind-required` if the socket has no baseline or the baseline's `playerId` does not match `verifiedPlayerId` -- this is the 'derive ... from verified connection/registry state' half of task 3.1.

src/lib/multiplayer/server/authorizeCampaignParticipation.ts:63-125 `admitCampaignParticipation()` -- the pure admission function: `acknowledgedRevision !== currentRevision` -> `stale-revision` (line 79-81); `forceUnits[payload.forceId]` absent -> `foreign-force` (line 82-85, 'missing force'); a force claimed by a DIFFERENT verified player in this mission's existing records -> `foreign-force` (line 100-107, the ownership-by-claim half, hardened later -- see crossNodeCoordinationRisk); role is computed server-side at line 141 (`role: verifiedPlayerId === hostPlayerId ? 'host' : 'guest'`), never read from the payload.

src/lib/multiplayer/server/authorizeCampaignParticipation.ts:132-148 `projectedRecord()` -- constructs the participation's `IForce` record itself, server-side, from `unitIds` looked up in the host's own `forceUnits` snapshot -- the client payload contributes only `forceId` (a string key), never a force object; this is the concrete mechanism behind 'reject full IForce'.
